subject: Life Skills
title: Taking Credit and Sharing It
description: Learn Taking Credit and Sharing It in one minute.

hook.text: A manager presented a team idea as her own. The team found out. Trust evaporated overnight.

buildup.text: Credit is social currency. Stealing it destroys loyalty faster than any pay cut ever could.

discovery.text: Name the contributor publicly. 'This was Raj's insight' costs you nothing and earns you enormous respect.

twist.text: Sharing credit does not shrink your share. Leaders who give credit freely are rated more competent, not less.

climax.text: Make it a habit: whenever you present, name at least one person who helped shape the idea.

punchline.text: Give credit loudly. Take blame quietly.

quiz.question: How are leaders who share credit perceived?
options: As weak and dependent on others
As unable to contribute original ideas
